item.tib: yi dam sgom bzlas kyi bsnyen dmigs man ngag zhal shes mdo sngags bcud 'dus
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni sgrab sde byang chub gling du/ dpal ldan ye shes dgon gyi gshen sde 'dus pa brgya phrag lhag pa dbang lung gdams pa'i tshod du phebs skabs/ spyang khyung grub pa'i gdung son nyams dang rtogs pa'i dbang phyug bla ma g.yung drung bdud 'dul dang / sum ldan ngur smig 'dzin pa mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / mkhyen spyan rnam pa bla ma bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal sogs mang pos gsung bskul ngor/ yi dam sgom bzlas byed pa rnams kyi ched du khod spungs dbra zhig ston pas dkyus thog gcig tu bris te sbyar ba'o//
